name: Haven Ridge
description: A fortified ridge-top community built from pre-war industrial salvage. The water tower is the tallest thing for kilometres in any direction. Laundry hangs between prefab walls. People watch you from doorways.

interactables.label: Bulletin Board
interactables.text: Scrawled notices on salvaged cardboard: a ration schedule for the week, a reward posting for anyone who can repair the ridge radio tower, and a warning about 'figures seen near the old silo' signed only with initials — C.F.

interactables.label: Water Tower
interactables.text: Rust-streaked but holding. Someone has painted a sun on the side — crude, faded, still somehow hopeful. The purifier hums beneath it.

ambient_description: The smell of cooked grain and rust. A child chasing a dog between the market stalls. Someone hammering in the distance.
